metadata.dataset: Intain Loan Performance Intelligence Engine Synthetic Datasets
metadata.description: Business validation and data quality rules for mortgage loan static attributes, monthly performance panels, and servicer updates.

financial_rules.name: Original Balance Positive
financial_rules.description: The original loan balance at origination must be strictly greater than zero.
financial_rules.message: Original loan balance must be greater than zero.

financial_rules.name: Current Balance Non-Negative
financial_rules.description: The outstanding principal balance in any performance month must be non-negative.
financial_rules.message: Current loan balance cannot be negative.

financial_rules.name: Current Balance Bounds
financial_rules.description: The outstanding principal balance must not exceed the origination balance.
financial_rules.message: Current loan balance cannot exceed original loan balance.

financial_rules.name: Original Balance Constant
financial_rules.description: Original balance of a loan must remain constant across all of its monthly historical records.
financial_rules.message: Original loan balance has changed over time for a single loan.

financial_rules.name: Interest Rate Bounds
financial_rules.description: Annual interest rate at origination must fall within a realistic mortgage rate boundary.
financial_rules.message: Interest rate is outside realistic mortgage industry bounds (2.0% - 11.0%).

temporal_rules.name: Reporting Date Sequence
temporal_rules.description: The reporting month must be greater than or equal to the loan origination month.
temporal_rules.message: Reporting month cannot occur before the loan's origination month.

temporal_rules.name: Loan Age Non-Negative
temporal_rules.description: Elapsed months since origination (loan age) cannot be negative.
temporal_rules.message: Loan age months cannot be negative.

temporal_rules.name: Remaining Term Non-Negative
temporal_rules.description: Remaining scheduled amortization term in months cannot be negative.
temporal_rules.message: Remaining term months cannot be negative.

temporal_rules.name: Month Index Sequence
temporal_rules.description: Month index must start at 0 at origination and increase sequentially by 1 for each reporting period.
temporal_rules.message: Month index sequence is broken or does not start at 0.

temporal_rules.name: Chronological Reporting Months
temporal_rules.description: Reporting month must increase chronologically without gaps or regressions within each loan history.
temporal_rules.message: Reporting months are not sorted chronologically or have gaps.

temporal_rules.name: Reporting Date Max Limit
temporal_rules.description: Reporting month must not be later than the configured maximum reporting date.
temporal_rules.message: Reporting month is later than the dataset's maximum configuration date (2026-07-01).

delinquency_rules.name: Allowed DPD Buckets
delinquency_rules.description: Days Past Due (DPD) must match defined industry reporting buckets.
delinquency_rules.message: Days past due value is invalid; must be 0, 30, 60, or 90.

delinquency_rules.name: Current Status DPD Check
delinquency_rules.description: A status of 'Current' must correspond to exactly zero days past due.
delinquency_rules.message: Loan marked as Current has a non-zero days past due value.

delinquency_rules.name: Delinquent Status DPD Check
delinquency_rules.description: A status of 'Delinquent' must correspond to greater than zero days past due.
delinquency_rules.message: Loan marked as Delinquent has zero days past due.

delinquency_rules.name: Default Status DPD Check
delinquency_rules.description: A status of 'Default' must correspond to the maximum delinquency bucket of 90 DPD.
delinquency_rules.message: Loan marked as Default has a days past due value other than 90.

delinquency_rules.name: Prepaid Status DPD Check
delinquency_rules.description: A prepaid loan must have zero days past due.
delinquency_rules.message: Loan marked as Prepaid has active delinquency (days past due > 0).

delinquency_rules.name: Logical Delinquency Progression
delinquency_rules.description: Delinquency transitions should roll sequentially (e.g., 0 to 30, 30 to 60, 60 to 90). Skipped DPD buckets raise warnings.
delinquency_rules.message: Non-sequential delinquency transition detected (e.g., loan jumped from 0 to 60 DPD in one month).

lifecycle_rules.name: Terminal Prepaid Status Check
lifecycle_rules.description: Prepaid status is terminal; no monthly observations can occur after a loan is prepaid.
lifecycle_rules.message: Monthly record exists for a loan after it reached Prepaid status.

lifecycle_rules.name: Terminal Default Status Check
lifecycle_rules.description: Default status is terminal; no monthly observations can occur after a loan defaults.
lifecycle_rules.message: Monthly record exists for a loan after it reached Default status.

lifecycle_rules.name: Prepayment Flag Consistency
lifecycle_rules.description: If prepayment_flag is set to 1, the loan's current_status must be Prepaid.
lifecycle_rules.message: Prepayment flag is set to 1 but current status is not 'Prepaid'.

lifecycle_rules.name: Default Flag Consistency
lifecycle_rules.description: If default_flag is set to 1, the loan's current_status must be Default.
lifecycle_rules.message: Default flag is set to 1 but current status is not 'Default'.

lifecycle_rules.name: Prepaid Balance Validation
lifecycle_rules.description: A prepaid loan must have a balance close to zero.
lifecycle_rules.message: Prepaid loan has a remaining balance exceeding standard residual limits.

lifecycle_rules.name: Default Loss Severity Check
lifecycle_rules.description: A default record must be associated with a valid loss severity band (Low, Medium, High).
lifecycle_rules.message: Defaulted loan has no loss severity band assigned.

lifecycle_rules.name: Non-Default Loss Severity Check
lifecycle_rules.description: Active or prepaid loans must have loss_severity_band set to None.
lifecycle_rules.message: Active or prepaid loan has a loss severity band assigned.

flag_consistency_rules.name: Modification Flag Binary
flag_consistency_rules.description: Modification flag must be either 0 or 1.
flag_consistency_rules.message: Invalid modification flag value; must be binary 0 or 1.

flag_consistency_rules.name: Prepayment Flag Binary
flag_consistency_rules.description: Prepayment flag must be either 0 or 1.
flag_consistency_rules.message: Invalid prepayment flag value; must be binary 0 or 1.

flag_consistency_rules.name: Default Flag Binary
flag_consistency_rules.description: Default flag must be either 0 or 1.
flag_consistency_rules.message: Invalid default flag value; must be binary 0 or 1.

flag_consistency_rules.name: Modification Delinquency Requirement
flag_consistency_rules.description: Loan modifications normally occur for delinquent accounts (DPD >= 60). Modifications on current/mildly delinquent loans trigger a warning.
flag_consistency_rules.message: Modification occurred on a loan with low delinquency (days past due < 60).

documentation_rules.name: Allowed Document Statuses
documentation_rules.description: Document status must be Complete, Pending, or Missing.
documentation_rules.message: Invalid document status value; must be 'Complete', 'Pending', or 'Missing'.

documentation_rules.name: Missing Document Exception Trigger
documentation_rules.description: If the document status is Missing, an exception must be required.
documentation_rules.message: Document status is Missing but exception_required is not set to 1.

documentation_rules.name: Missing Document Exception Classification
documentation_rules.description: If the document status is Missing, exception_type must indicate Documentation Gap.
documentation_rules.message: Document status is Missing but exception_type is not 'Documentation Gap'.

categorical_rules.name: Allowed Credit Score Bands
categorical_rules.description: Credit score band must match underwriting guidelines.

categorical_rules.name: Allowed LTV Bands
categorical_rules.description: Origination Loan-to-Value band must match underwriting guidelines.

categorical_rules.name: Allowed DTI Bands
categorical_rules.description: Origination Debt-to-Income band must match underwriting guidelines.

categorical_rules.name: Allowed Loan Purposes
categorical_rules.description: Loan purpose must match valid categories.
categorical_rules.message: Loan purpose must be either 'Purchase' or 'Refinance'.

categorical_rules.name: Allowed Occupancy Types
categorical_rules.description: Property occupancy type must match valid categories.

categorical_rules.name: Allowed Property Types
categorical_rules.description: Property architecture type must match valid categories.

categorical_rules.name: Allowed Source Systems
categorical_rules.description: Supplying database system must be a registered source.

servicer_reconciliation_rules.name: Servicer Update Source ID Unique
servicer_reconciliation_rules.description: Each update record in the servicer feed must have a unique identifier.
servicer_reconciliation_rules.message: Duplicate source record ID found in servicer update feed.

servicer_reconciliation_rules.name: Servicer Timestamp Order
servicer_reconciliation_rules.description: Servicer local system modification timestamp must be older than feed receipt timestamp.
servicer_reconciliation_rules.message: Servicer update date cannot occur after the system record receipt date.

servicer_reconciliation_rules.name: Servicer Receipt Date Bounds
servicer_reconciliation_rules.description: The servicer updates feed cannot be received before the close of the reporting month.
servicer_reconciliation_rules.message: Servicer update was received before the reporting period month closed.

servicer_reconciliation_rules.name: Servicer Balance Non-Negative
servicer_reconciliation_rules.description: Servicer reported outstanding balance cannot be negative.
servicer_reconciliation_rules.message: Servicer reported a negative outstanding balance.

servicer_reconciliation_rules.name: Servicer DPD Allowed Values
servicer_reconciliation_rules.description: Servicer reported days past due must be in valid delinquency buckets.
servicer_reconciliation_rules.message: Servicer reported an invalid days past due bucket.

servicer_reconciliation_rules.name: Servicer Status Allowed Values
servicer_reconciliation_rules.description: Servicer reported credit status must be Current, Delinquent, Default, or Prepaid.
servicer_reconciliation_rules.message: Servicer reported an invalid credit status.

servicer_reconciliation_rules.name: Expected Partial Update Null Fields
servicer_reconciliation_rules.description: Updates marked as PARTIAL_UPDATE are expected to contain missing fields; this should be flagged as informational, not a data error.
servicer_reconciliation_rules.message: PARTIAL_UPDATE feed contains expected null values.

servicer_reconciliation_rules.name: Expected Stale Record Lag
servicer_reconciliation_rules.description: Updates marked as STALE represent unprocessed local system updates. Timestamp lag is expected.
servicer_reconciliation_rules.message: Stale update record has expected historical timestamp latency.

servicer_reconciliation_rules.name: Expected Conflict Mismatches
servicer_reconciliation_rules.description: Updates marked as CONFLICT represent feed errors or mismatch flags for reconciliation testing.
servicer_reconciliation_rules.message: Conflict update record contains an expected discrepancies flag.

duplicate_rules.name: Unique Loan Origination Records
duplicate_rules.description: Each loan_id must appear exactly once in the loan static attributes database.
duplicate_rules.message: Duplicate loan ID record found in origination database.

duplicate_rules.name: Unique Monthly Loan Observations
duplicate_rules.description: The combination of loan_id and reporting_month must be unique across all performance panel records.
duplicate_rules.message: Duplicate monthly reporting period found for a single loan.
